results.title: مدير المنتخب اليمني لـ«عكاظ»: جهوزيتنا عالية لمواجهة قطر والجمهور سندنا
results.description: أكد لـ«عكاظ» مدير المنتخب اليمني أسعد القماسي، أن المملكة العربية السعودية وفرت كافة أسباب ومقومات النجاح لجميع المنتخبات المشاركة في بطولة كأس الخليج العربي «خليجي 27»، مشيداً بالبنية التحتية والتجهيزات الاستثنائية التي سخرتها المملكة لإخراج البطولة بأفضل صورة ممكنة، واصفاً الحدث بأنه بمثابة «كأس عالم مصغر». وأوضح القماسي، أن التحضيرات الفنية والبدنية لـ«الأحمر اليمني» لمواجهة المنتخب القطري مساء اليوم (الأحد)، تسير بصورة ممتازة وفي أجواء إيجابية، مؤكداً أن الجهاز الفني واللاعبين يملكون الجاهزية الكاملة للظهور بمستوى يليق بتاريخ وتطلعات الكرة اليمنية. وشدد مدير المنتخب اليمني على الرهان الكبير على دعم ومؤازرة الجماهير اليمنية، قائلاً: «الجمهور هو سندنا الحقيقي الداعم لنا في كل الميادين، ونعدهم بتقديم أداء شجاع ومشرّف على أرضية الملعب يترجم حجم الدعم والاهتمام، ويعكس مدى التحضير الجاد لهذه المواجهة المهمة في المسيرة الخليجية».

results.title: Israeli minister calls for Gaza-style war in occupied West Bank
results.description: JERUSALEM — Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich on Sunday called for a military campaign in the occupied West Bank similar to Israel’s war in the Gaza Strip.Israel “should do there what we did in Gaza,” Smotrich told Israeli newspaper Yedioth Ahronoth.Smotrich also renewed his call for dismantling the Palestinian Authority, which exercises limited self-rule in parts of the occupied West Bank.His remarks come amid tightened Israeli restrictions on Palestinian movement across the territory, including checkpoint closures and roadblocks that have isolated communities and restricted access to workplaces, homes and essential services.Violence in the occupied West Bank has escalated sharply since the Gaza war began in October 2023.More than 1,206 Palestinians have been killed, over 13,300 wounded and nearly 26,000 arrested by Israeli forces and settlers during that period, according to Palestinian figures.Israeli operations and settler attacks have also included the demolition of homes and other structures, attacks on mosques, the bulldozing of farmland, restrictions on farmers’ access to their land, displacement of Palestinians and the expansion of Israeli settlements.In Gaza, nearly 74,000 Palestinians have been killed and more than 175,000 wounded since the war began in October 2023, according to Palestinian health authorities. Palestinian officials say around 90% of the enclave’s infrastructure has been destroyed or damaged.Israel has faced accusations of genocide over its conduct in Gaza, allegations it has rejected.Despite a ceasefire that took effect on Oct. 10, 2025, Gaza’s Health Ministry says Israeli attacks have since killed more than 1,400 Palestinians and wounded around 5,000 others.

results.title: At least 27 killed in two mass shootings in South Africa
results.description: JOHANNESBURG — At least 27 people were killed and 26 others wounded in two separate mass shootings in South Africa’s Gauteng and Western Cape provinces, police said Sunday.Seventeen people were shot dead at a tavern in Wedela, in the West Rand District of Gauteng province, on Saturday night. The victims included 13 men and four women, police said.Another 15 people sustained gunshot wounds and were taken to medical facilities for treatment.“It is alleged that patrons were drinking inside and outside the tavern when the suspects arrived and opened fire on those outside. The suspects then entered the tavern and continued shooting at patrons inside,” police said in a statement.The attackers were reportedly armed with AK-47 rifles and shotguns. Police said they searched some patrons and took their cellphones before fleeing in two unidentified vehicles.Two vehicles parked near the tavern were also set alight.Police launched a manhunt for eight unidentified armed men suspected of involvement in the attack. The motive remains unknown, while detectives and specialized units have been deployed to identify and apprehend the suspects.In a separate incident, 10 people were shot dead in Lwandle in the Western Cape province early Sunday after gunmen entered an entertainment venue and opened fire on patrons, police said.Five people died at the scene, while another five succumbed to their injuries after being taken to medical facilities. Eleven others were receiving treatment for their injuries.The latest attacks come amid persistent concerns over violent crime in South Africa, where an average of about 58 people are murdered each day, according to national crime statistics.Last week, gunmen killed 11 people, including a pregnant woman, and wounded three others in a late-night shooting at a home in southern Durban.

results.title: Major incident declared near US air base in England after explosives arrests
results.description: LONDON — A major incident was declared Sunday in a village near a US air base in western England, with residents evacuated from several properties after police arrested several men on suspicion of offenses under the Explosives Act.Gloucestershire Police said evacuations were underway in Whelford, near RAF Fairford, a Royal Air Force base that hosts United States Air Force operations.Residents were taken to a leisure center while emergency services investigated the incident.“The Army’s specialist explosive ordnance disposal team is currently examining a number of vehicles,” police said.A cordon was established around the area, with police saying they believed the incident was contained.A large emergency services presence was reported at the scene, including a Hazardous Area Response Team, which provides specialist medical support during incidents involving hazardous materials and other complex emergencies, according to the BBC.“A number of properties are currently being evacuated in the Whelford area following the declaration of a major incident,” Gloucestershire Police said.“It follows the arrest of several men on suspicion of offenses under the Explosives Act.”Police said the investigation remained ongoing and urged the public to avoid the affected area while emergency services continued their work.

results.title: At least 10 missing after avalanche strikes Nepal’s Himlung Himal
results.description: KATHMANDU — At least 10 people, including climbers and support staff, are missing after an avalanche struck the 7,126-meter (23,379-foot) Himlung Himal in Nepal’s western Manang district, local media reported Sunday.Ram Krishna Lamichhane, director general of Nepal’s Department of Tourism, confirmed the incident and said authorities were gathering further details as efforts continued to locate and rescue those unaccounted for, the Kathmandu Post reported.The avalanche struck amid persistent rain and snowfall across Nepal’s western mountainous region.Elsewhere in the country, at least one person was killed and two others went missing after a landslide struck a settlement in Palpa district on Sunday.In neighboring Parbat district, the Kaligandaki River flooded a settlement, washing away around 80 houses.The latest incidents come a month after massive flash floods struck Nepal, killing more than 1,350 people and leaving more than 5,000 others missing.
